title: PracticePay Returned-Payment-Fee Relief: Replacement Timing Share
content:
**Rule.** On PracticePay Patient Financing, the replacement timing share of a returned-payment-fee relief counts the days from the return date to the replacement date: no more than 2 days gives 1, more than 2 and no more than 10 days gives 0.9, and more than 10 days gives 0.75; a span of days here being counted from the day after its start date through its end date.

The return date is the date of the returned-payment entry; the replacement date is the date of the latest payment entry credited toward the same due date that has not come back.

| Days from the return date to the replacement date | Share |
|---|---|
| 1 or 2 | 1 |
| 3 to 10 | 0.9 |
| 11 or more | 0.75 |

*Hypothetical.* Return dated 4 August: a replacement dated 6 August (2 days) takes 1; one dated 7 August (3 days) takes 0.9; one dated 14 August (10 days) takes 0.9; one dated 15 August (11 days) takes 0.75.
